The Eucharist is our daily bread, given to sustain us on the journey. It is the food of pilgrims, the viaticum for the journey to eternity. Let us receive it often, with devotion and gratitude.
Let the Eucharist be the center of each day. Let it be the source of our strength and the pledge of our hope. In this bread, we have all that we need.
devotionals.prayer: Lord, let the Eucharist be my daily bread. Sustain me on the journey to eternal life. Amen.

devotionals.title: The Sacrament of Unity
devotionals.source: Book Four — Summary Reflection
devotionals.body:
The Eucharist is the sacrament of unity. It unites us with Christ and with one another. Many grains become one bread; many grapes become one wine. We, though many, are one body in Christ.
Let this unity transform our relationships. Let us be one as Christ and the Father are one. Let the Eucharist heal our divisions and make us one family in God.
devotionals.prayer: Lord, let the Eucharist unite me with You and with Your Church. Heal our divisions and make us one. Amen.

devotionals.title: The Pledge of Glory
devotionals.source: Book Four — Summary Reflection
devotionals.body:
The Eucharist is the pledge of future glory. In receiving Christ now, we receive the promise of eternal life. He who eats this bread will live forever. The Eucharist is the foretaste of heaven.
Let us live in the light of this promise. The Eucharist gives us a glimpse of the eternal banquet. Let it fill us with hope and sustain us until we see God face to face.
devotionals.prayer: Lord, let the Eucharist be my pledge of eternal life. Sustain me with this bread until I see You face to face. Amen.

devotionals.title: The Complete Imitation
devotionals.source: The Imitation of Christ — Conclusion
devotionals.body:
We have walked through all four books of The Imitation of Christ. We have been called to humility, to the interior life, to internal consolation, and to Holy Communion. The journey has been long, but the goal is before us.
The imitation of Christ is not complete until we have followed Him all the way to the Father. The Eucharist is our food for the journey, our strength for the path, and our foretaste of the destination.
devotionals.prayer: Lord, let the imitation of Christ be the work of my whole life. Lead me through humility to glory, through the cross to the resurrection. Amen.

devotionals.title: The Grace of Perseverance
devotionals.source: The Imitation of Christ — Conclusion
devotionals.body:
Perseverance is the key. Many begin the journey; few reach the end. The trials are many, but the reward is great. Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due season we will reap if we do not give up.
The grace of perseverance is a gift for which we must pray daily. Lord, keep me faithful to the end. Let me finish the race and keep the faith.
devotionals.prayer: Lord, grant me the grace of perseverance. Keep me faithful to the end, that I may receive the crown of life. Amen.

devotionals.title: The Life of Constant Conversion
devotionals.source: The Imitation of Christ — Conclusion
devotionals.body:
The spiritual life is a life of constant conversion. Every day we must turn again to God. Every day we must take up the cross. Every day we must choose Christ anew.
Let us not be discouraged by our failures. The mercy of the Lord is new every morning. Great is His faithfulness. He who began a good work in us will bring it to completion.
devotionals.prayer: Lord, let my life be one of constant conversion. Every day, turn me again toward You. Amen.

devotionals.title: The Hope of Glory
devotionals.source: The Imitation of Christ — Conclusion
devotionals.body:
Our hope is in the glory that awaits. The sufferings of this present time are not worth comparing with the glory that shall be revealed. We are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been made known.
But we know that when Christ appears, we shall be like Him, for we shall see Him as He is. This hope purifies us, sustains us, and draws us forward. Maranatha! Come, Lord Jesus!
devotionals.prayer: Lord, I live in the hope of Your coming. Let this hope purify my life and sustain me until that glorious day. Amen.

devotionals.title: Into the Hands of God
devotionals.source: The Imitation of Christ — Conclusion
devotionals.body:
The final word of The Imitation of Christ is surrender. Into Your hands, O Lord, I commend my spirit. I have done what I can; You must do what I cannot. I trust in Your mercy; I hope in Your love; I long for Your presence.
The journey of 365 days has brought us full circle. We began with the call to follow Christ; we end with the surrender of all to God. This is the path: from following to abiding, from striving to resting, from seeking to finding.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God the Father, and the communion of the Holy Spirit be with us all, now and forever. Amen.
devotionals.prayer: Lord, into Your hands I commend my spirit. You have led me through this year of devotion. Now lead me into eternal life. Amen.
